advice: Urine may turn red after rifampicin; skin darkens with clofazimine and fades after treatment. Report painful nerves, new patches, eye redness or weakness immediately (reaction). Check G6PD and CBC for dapsone. Examine household contacts.
name: Leprosy – MB-MDT (adult, WHO)

rx.drug: Cap. Clofazimine 300 mg monthly + 50 mg daily
rx.instr: Monthly dose supervised; 50 mg daily self-administered
